learnings.insight: Developer tool integration quality commands premium valuations

learnings.impact: Validates focus on integration quality over feature count
learnings.application_to_chained: Prioritize agent deployment ease and integration quality; position as infrastructure rather than tooling

learnings.evidence: Google's handwriting recognition model achieves near-perfect accuracy in real-world deployment
learnings.impact: Multimodal AI transitioning from research to production use cases
learnings.application_to_chained: Monitor multimodal agent applications for future relevance (low priority currently)

learnings.insight: Prompt engineering creates significant quality gaps
learnings.evidence: Nano Banana's advanced prompting techniques enable nuanced control, demonstrating skill gap in prompt quality
learnings.impact: Agent instruction quality directly affects output quality

learnings.evidence: Google Code Wiki positions collaborative documentation as strategic platform play
learnings.impact: Good documentation accelerates adoption and reduces support burden

learnings.insight: Developer productivity tools are strategic infrastructure

learnings.impact: Developer tools market maturing into infrastructure tier investments
learnings.application_to_chained: Position agent orchestration as developer productivity infrastructure, not optional tooling
